summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd (formerly Jeffs' Brands), an Israeli foreign private issuer on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a revised reverse share split ratio of 1-for-8, superseding the previously announced 1-for-5, approved by the board and effective November 6, 2026, when shares trade post-split at the open. Issued and outstanding ordinary shares fall from 4,219,763 to approximately 527,471, with authorized capital unchanged, fractional shares rounded up at the DTC participant level, and proportionate adjustments to warrant and option exercise prices and share counts. This is a routine share-consolidation notice, not a special situation.
